quote: The goal of explainable recommendation is to provide an explanation to a user for a recommended item, so as to justify how the recommendation might match his/her interests. That is, given a pair of user ID and item ID, the system needs to generate an explanation.
The goal of explanation generation is to generate a natural language sentence Êu,i for a pair of user u and item i to justify why i is recommended to u.

Recent years have witnessed the successful application of natural language generation. Many of the applications in fact require certain degree of personalization, such as explainable recommendation , review generation , review summarization , and conversational systems .
outputs: Generated natural-language explanations (sentences) for user-item recommendation pairs

quote: As to explanation performance, we measure the generated explanations from two main perspectives: text quality and explainability. For the former, we adopt BLEU in machine translation and ROUGE in text summarization, and report BLEU-1 and BLEU-4, and Precision, Recall and F1 of ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2. ... we adopt USR that computes the Unique Sentence Ratio ...
